mapper.select: SELECT NVL(SUM(NVL(AMOUNT * 100, 0)), 0) FROM ( SELECT SUM(NVL(SHARE_AMT, 0)) AS AMOUNT FROM TRD_PRODUCT_DEAL WHERE SPLIT_TRADE_ID = #{tradeId} AND IS_CANCEL != 'Y' GROUP BY SPLIT_TRADE_ID UNION ALL SELECT SUM (NVL(SHARE_AMT, 0)) AS AMOUNT FROM WFL_TRD_PRODUCT_DEAL WHERE SPLIT_TRADE_ID = #{tradeId} AND IS_CANCEL != 'Y' GROUP BY SPLIT_TRADE_ID )
